prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: hit while turning left in Pearland, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported neck strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1191; do not mention it.)
text: Officer narrative: On arrival at the intersection in Pearland, Texas, I observed a two-vehicle collision involving a sedan and an SUV. Driver 1 stated that they were traveling straight through the intersection when the SUV, operated by Driver 2, turned left across their path and struck the driver's side of the sedan. Driver 2 stated that they began the turn when the traffic signal allowed, and did not see the sedan approaching until impact. A passenger was present in the sedan and was not reported injured. Driver 1 reported neck strain and declined transport by EMS at the scene, though they were advised to seek medical evaluation if symptoms worsened. Both vehicles sustained front-end and side damage and were towed from the scene. Weather was clear and the roadway was dry. Traffic citations were pending completion of the investigation.
